gate: Hash frozen before the holdout. Official engine 1.32.7, fresh seeds never used for the table, both seats, the two embedded candidates play the same panel as paired controls. Gate: the router's total score >= the better control's total + 4 and >= the weaker control's + 8; against no opponent below the better of the two controls by more than 2.0 (one world, both seats); no reported errors or shadow errors; every callback < 1000 ms. Then the Kaggle kernel rebuilds the router from its parts, checks the hash and repeats the paired comparison against f11b_hs3_lock on four fresh seeds (total > 0, no opponent below the control). Registered before the run.
